newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish prisoners free remaining hostages - minister.
newsitem.headline: Irish prisoners free remaining hostages - minister.

text.p: Four prison officers held hostage by inmates at Dublin's Mountjoy jail for more than 48 hours were freed late on Monday night, Irish Justice Minister Nora Owen told reporters.
The releases followed a day of intensive negotiations between Irish government officials and six prisoners from the jail's isolation wing.
The inmates, who were armed with iron bars, originally took five officers hostage after an exercise session on Saturday night, but quickly released one.
The prisoners had been angry at alleged ill-treatment and overcrowding.

One of them, Paul Ward, who is facing charges of conspiracy to murder Irish investigative journalist Veronica Guerin, was also protesting his innocence. Guerin was gunned down in her car in Dublin last June.
No political prisoners or members of Northern Irish guerrilla groups are held at the prison.
